closingSelfCheck.summary: All 3 checklist items' promises are delivered and independently reproduced live, including both plan.md amendments (command registered via 4 files, not code-only). git diff main...HEAD contains no TODO/FIXME/HACK. CLAUDE.md states the engineered-failing-run gap as an accepted limitation, in the same section a reader meets the feature, and never claims it is prevented or mechanically excluded -- confirmed both by direct read and by the CHK-003/C4 overclaim-grep test passing. The story's own evidence selectors ([PASS] <caseId> ... vs [FAIL] <caseId> ...) are printed conditionally per-case, unlike the B-a745 defect (a string printed on every branch) this story exists to fix, so the story's own evidence would survive its own defect. One caveat is not a delivery gap but worth recording: the taught refusal command's literal placeholder form (<stricter>/<why>) fails the CLI's own reason-length schema if pasted verbatim rather than filled in, which I verified live; this is consistent with the documented placeholder convention and with CHK-003/C8's design (it substitutes real values before asserting the form runs), not a broken promise.
